purpose_context: #849 is the decisive test for the Life Lattice graph layer: three arms answer the same eight questions over a frozen, oracle-backed corpus, scored on correctness and input tokens per correct answer. The corpus, loader, run harness and gate measurements already exist and are frozen; this mission builds the arms on office4, runs the 72-cell primary matrix and the D-YaRN secondary, and delivers a ledger the design lead can grade blind. The result reads directly on whether the typed graph earns or kills #693.
purpose_tldr: Build the three retrieval arms (graph, full-dump, vector-RAG) and run the pre-registered #849 comparison so #692's build direction is decided by measurement, not argument.
